item.title: Annotello 1.2.2
item.description:
What's new in 1.2.2

  • Signed and notarized by Apple: Annotello now opens without any security warnings.
  • Automatic updates: Annotello checks for new versions daily and installs them in one click.
  • Check for Updates… is available from the menu bar icon, the capture panel's ⋯ menu, the app menu and Settings.
  • Settings › General has a new Updates row to turn automatic checks on or off.
